notes:
Account: ConversioFlow Systems — mid-market B2B SaaS (in-app customer support + automated triage).

Summary: evaluating Redwood Hosted API as first step (fast onboarding) with a plan to move to Dedicated if throughput/latency and pricing justify. Primary driver: migration from incumbent LLM API after multiple latency regressions affected SLAs for chat assistants. Product team wants deterministic streaming + reliable tool-calls (internal search, billing lookups).

What they told us (paraphrase / direct):
- "We had three incidents last quarter where average session latency doubled due to tokenization changes on incumbent — customers noticed. Need predictable tail behavior." — Head of Product (Gina Alvarez).
- Cost is important but they put latency first for now: 99th percentile tail impacts NPS and retention.

POC notes (current):
- 2026-02-18: kickoff demo + architecture review (Maya + Lucas + AWS infra). Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_0915.
- 2026-02-23: sample agent integration (streaming enabled) — integrated tool-calling hook to internal search API (auth via service role).
- 2026-03-02: 4-hour benchmark run comparing Redwood streaming vs incumbent across 3 agents (support-chat, billing-assistant, onboarding-guide). Fireflies: ff_2026-03-02_1001.
- 2026-03-05: follow-up call to review benchmark results and discuss Dedicated pricing band.

Benchmark highlights (observed in POC):
- Redwood streaming: P50 ~ 40-60ms to first-byte, P95 ~ 170-220ms, P99 ~ 380-520ms depending on tool-call payloads.
- Incumbent: P50 comparable for light prompts but P95 ~ 420-560ms, P99 spikes > 1s on several runs (caused by retry/backoff behavior).
- Observed faster time-to-first-byte on Redwood streaming; tool-call chaining completed more consistently (fewer mid-call timeouts).
- End-to-end session latency improvements reduced average user-perceived reply time by ~30% in our simulated traffic mix.

Cost & pricing:
- Redwood hosted: list-pricing slightly above incumbent per 1M tokens, but effective cost lower in POC due to fewer retries and reduced session duration.
- Interested in Dedicated commit if Redwood can meet published tail SLOs and provide a predictable pricing tier for 24/7 agent traffic.

Security / procurement:
- Completed initial security questionnaire items; still need SOC2 cert copy, endpoint hardening guidance, and KMS integration diagram (linked in drive).
- Legal looking at incumbent termination fees (may prefer overlap window). Procurement flagged budget for H2.

Next steps (short):
- Run 48-hour high-concurrency stress test (team to provide synthetic traffic profile by 2026-03-12).
- SE (Lucas) to share dedicated pricing bands and trade-off scenarios for batching/quantization.
- Send SOC2 evidence + KMS integration pattern (Maya to attach to Drive link).

Rep notes / tactical:
- AE (Maya) should push for a short Dedicated trial window clause in commercial to handle migration overlap.
- Keep messaging on streaming tail numbers — product cares about P95/P99 more than P50.
- Watch for procurement timeline friction around incumbent cancellation fees.
